title: Orthopny
summary: ORTHOP'NY, noun [Gr. right, erect, and breath; to breathe.] 1. A species of asthma in which respiration can be performed on in an erect posture. 2. Any difficulty of breathing.

inlines.v: ORTHOP'NY, noun [Gr. right, erect, and breath; to breathe.] 1. A species of asthma in which respiration can be performed on in an erect posture. 2. Any difficulty of breathing.
